nodes.description: Address of the Ferrum bot protection contract stored in BotProtected; used for external callback in checkBots and list.
Address of the Uniswap/Pancake trading pair, set in constructor via pairForPancake and passed to the bot protection callback.
Privileged owner address, assigned from tx.origin in the MediaLicensingToken constructor and gates delegate and list.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom and directly overwritten by list.
Public nested allowance mapping read/decremented in transferFrom and written in approve and constructor.
Total token supply (200000000000000000000000000) used as the basis for allocations inside list.
UniswapV2Router02 instance used for addLiquidityETH in list; its allowance is set to uint(-1) in the constructor.
Wrapped native token address used with address(this) as input to pairForPancake in the constructor.
Modifier performing an external low-level call to stopTheBots (selector 0x15274141) before the function body executes.
BotProtected constructor storing the bot protection contract address in stopTheBots.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; adjusts allowance and balances with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emitting Approval.
Owner-only public function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
Internal pure function computing the deterministic pair address via keccak256 and the Pancake init-code hash.
Owner-only payable function that sets balances, adds liquidity via uniRouter, invokes stopTheBots, and loops over recipient arrays.
MediaLicensingToken constructor setting owner from tx.origin, computing uniPair and granting unlimited allowances.
msg.sender, external caller address used for authorization and as transfer source.
tx.origin, used directly as the owner and unlimited-allowance holder in the constructor.
block.timestamp, used to build the addLiquidityETH deadline in list.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) executed in delegate, granting full storage/code control to the target.
Low-level stopTheBots.call with selector 0x15274141 (in checkBots) or 0xd5eaf4c3 (in list) returning isNotBot; ignored success/default data.
External call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH transferring msg.value and approving token liquidity.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value raw subtraction without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value raw subtraction without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value raw addition without SafeMath.
Assignment owner = tx.origin, making ownership phishing/tx.origin dependent.
Constructor argument address forwarded to BotProtected to set stopTheBots.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/checkBots controlling whose balance is debited.

Calldata bytes passed to the delegatecall in delegate.
Token amount used both as contract balance and liquidity amount in list.
Array of recipient addresses receiving balances in the list loop.
Array of amounts assigned to each recipient in the list loop.
First token address sorted inside pairForPancake.
Second token address sorted inside pairForPancake.
Lower-ordered token address computed in pairForPancake.
Higher-ordered token address computed in pairForPancake.
Computed pair address returned by pairForPancake.
Loop counter in list.
Boolean returned by stopTheBots.call in checkBots used in require.
Returned bytes from stopTheBots.call in checkBots.
